verdict.rationale: The self-hosting docs say Jitsu's connector syncs run as Kubernetes CronJobs, which implies recurring, scheduled sync jobs inside the product. The Management API also covers managing syncs. Scheduling is shown only as a deployment detail for connector syncs, not as a user-configurable scheduler for arbitrary jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: documented user-facing schedule configuration (cron/interval settings), scheduling of jobs beyond connector syncs (e.g. functions or general workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
